body_html: Get to Know Jah:  DJ Jah comes to us from Boston and a family history of music and DJing!  He first was introduced to DJing by his dad who also is a DJ!  When he is not DJing he enjoys painting, exercising, MMA, Reading Comics and video games, snowboarding, and surfing! What’s in Jah’s Headphones?:  Depends on the mood, Anything from Afro Beats, Reggae, Country, Rock, House Music, Jazz, or Rap”. Jah’s other Talents:  Jah is also an actor, Model and FYI, dabbles in Real Estate, so if you need an agent, he can do that too!
